policies.B1: An applicant achieves capital reserve qualification when paid-in equity reaches at least 4,000,000 USD.
policies.B2: Primary solvency clearance is granted to an applicant that achieves capital reserve qualification.
policies.D1: Institutional trading approval is granted to an entity with primary solvency clearance that maintains a regulatory risk score of at least 80 points.
policies.B3: Cross-border authorization is conferred when an enterprise holds an international brokerage licence.
policies.B4: International account permission is granted to a candidate holding cross-border authorization.
policies.D2: Overseas market participation is awarded to a candidate with international account permission that employs at least 10 certified compliance officers.
policies.B5: High-revenue designation is attained when yearly turnover reaches at least 10,000,000 USD.
policies.B6: Tier-one commercial status is conferred upon an entity securing high-revenue designation.
policies.D3: Expedited underwriting clearance requires tier-one commercial status together with an operational risk rating of at least 70 points.
policies.B7: Verification credibility status is established if a firm generates turnover of at least 10,000,000 USD per year, holds a commercial banking charter, or maintains an international credit rating of at least 75 points.
policies.D4: Priority processing approval is awarded to any firm holding verification credibility status.
policies.B8: Baseline onboarding clearance requires an enterprise to satisfy at least one condition: maintaining paid-in equity of 4,000,000 USD or higher, holding an international brokerage licence, or maintaining an ISO 27001 security certification.
policies.D5: Corporate account authorization is extended to an enterprise with baseline onboarding clearance that holds a liquid cash reserve of at least 1,500,000 USD.
policies.B9: Comprehensive governance certification is granted when an entity with yearly turnover of 10,000,000 USD or more holds institutional tier 1 status and conducts at least 4 AML compliance audits per year.
policies.B10: Corporate syndicate clearance is granted to a firm with comprehensive governance certification that maintains a corporate guarantee of at least 8,000,000 USD.
policies.D6: Prime brokerage access is extended to any client with corporate syndicate clearance.
policies.B11: Short-term solvency clearance is achieved when an enterprise maintains an emergency liquidity reserve of at least 400,000 USD.
policies.B12: Accreditation as a fund manager is granted when managed assets equal or exceed 5,000,000 USD.
